_readme: Central animation registry. Read-only reference for developers: does not affect runtime. Each collection section documents where the assets live, what pipeline uses them, and their current status. When doing a full swap, the 'clips' collection is the primary source of truth for the runtime (manifest.json is generated from scripts/animations.config.json).

clips.description: Built Mixamo clips retargeted to the Avaturn rig. These are the animations active in the main runtime. Sources are FBX files in public/animations/, built via scripts/build-animations.mjs into JSON clips in public/animations/clips/. The runtime loads these via public/animations/manifest.json.

items.name: av-offabean-dance
items.label: Offabean Dance
items._note: Source round-tripped through glTF-Transform, so its hips track is metre-scale (not Mixamo's usual centimetres) and carries a baked ~1.45m armature offset. Built with recenterHips:true; unit handling is automatic.

items.name: torch-light
items.label: Light Torch
items.source_fbx: animation-sources/Standing Torch Light Torch From Fire.fbx

items.name: torch-light-wall
items.label: Light Torch (Wall)
items.source_fbx: animation-sources/Standing Torch Light Torch From Wall.fbx

items.name: sitidle
items.label: Sit Idle
items.note: Hand-authored 2-key pose, no FBX source (commit 7a22e5993). Merged into manifest.json by build-animations.mjs from scripts/animations-extra-clips.json (previously orphaned; see known_issues history).

presets_robotexpressive.description: Legacy fallback presets from the Three.js RobotExpressive GLB. Written by scripts/download-animations.mjs. Not fetched by any current src/ code: superseded by the clips collection. Kept for reference and potential fallback use.

lora_pipeline.description: FBX files used exclusively by the character-studio LoRA/pose capture pipeline. Not retargeted or available to the main runtime. Used to render pose reference images for LoRA training.

sprite_atlas_pipeline.description: FBX files used exclusively by the character-studio sprite atlas generator. Not available to the main runtime.

sims_demo.description: Animation clips embedded in AnimationLibrary.glb for the sims-demo character controller. Mapped to movement states by AnimatedCharacterModel.jsx and AgentCharacterModel.jsx.

agent_slots.description: The fixed slot vocabulary used by the agent avatar system (src/runtime/animation-slots.js). Slots are resolved to clip names from the 'clips' collection at runtime. Agents can override individual slots via meta.edits.animations.

bow.status: active (approximation): no bow clip is baked; 'sitclap' reads as gratitude/applause. See known_issues: bow-slot-approximation

fidget.status: fixed 2026-07-08, was 'Fidget' (no such clip, silent no-op); see resolved known_issues entry below

known_issues.description: The 'bow' slot has no dedicated clip: it resolves to 'sitclap' (Sitting Clap), which reads as gratitude/applause rather than a bow. Every other slot now plays a clip that means what the slot means. Fix: add Mixamo 'Bowing' (In Place, Without Skin) to animation-sources/, register it in scripts/animations.config.json as 'bow', run npm run build:animations, then point DEFAULT_ANIMATION_MAP.bow at it. tests/animation-slots.test.js already asserts the target exists, so the swap is a one-line change once the clip is baked.

resolved_issues.description: The skill hints 'gesture', 'inspect', 'present', 'sign', 'curiosity' and 'patience' are now slots (or aliases onto one) in src/runtime/animation-slots.js, and src/agent-avatar.js _onSkillStart routes animationHint through resolveHint() → _playSlot instead of passing the raw hint to _triggerOneShot, which only ever matched a clip embedded in the GLB. 'inspect' and 'gesture' alone account for 38 of the ~50 hint declarations in the skill catalog, so this was the most-hit dead path in the animation system. tests/animation-slots.test.js now scans every animationHint literal under src/ and fails if one resolves to no slot or to a clip missing from the manifest.

Oversight, now fixed: the 'wave', 'nod', 'point', 'think' and 'shrug' slots borrowed 'reaction'/'pray'/'defeated' from before their dedicated clips were baked, which left five real clips unreachable by any slot or hint. Each slot now plays its own clip, and the walk state machine's matching gestures (src/animation-state-machine.js) were re-pointed with them: 'shrug' also moved to the upper-body overlay layer, since a shoulder shrug does not need to suppress locomotion the way the borrowed full-body 'defeated' clip did.

The 6 FBX files formerly listed under 'orphaned_fbx' (Cover To Stand, Goalkeeper Scoop, 3x Jumping Down, Removing Driver) are now in scripts/animations.config.json as coverstand/goalkeeper/jumpdown/jumpdown2/jumpdown3/removing and built into the manifest.

DEFAULT_ANIMATION_MAP.fidget now points at the real 'av-waiting' clip instead of the never-baked 'Fidget'. Covered by tests/animation-slots.test.js, which asserts every slot's default clip exists in manifest.json.

The 'sitidle' hand-authored pose clip existed as a file but was missing from manifest.json, so AnimationManager.crossfadeTo('sitidle')/canPlay('sitidle') silently failed for the state machine's 'sit' gesture (src/animation-state-machine.js): a dead path with no console warning. build-animations.mjs now merges scripts/animations-extra-clips.json into every curated manifest rebuild so hand-authored clips survive future rebuilds. Covered by tests/embodiment-emotion.test.js's full-GESTURES manifest check.
